title: The Friend Who Became Family
body:
Some friendships start with a simple introduction.

A classroom seat.
A project team.
A casual conversation.

Nothing seems special at first.

Then years pass.

You celebrate victories together. You face challenges together. You support each other through difficult times.

Slowly, the friendship becomes something deeper.

You stop introducing them as "a friend."

They become family in everything except blood.

These relationships are rare, and they remind us that family is not always defined by birth. Sometimes it is defined by loyalty, trust, and time.

"The strongest friendships are built so well that they start feeling like family."

meta_description: A classroom seat, a project team, a casual chat. A NIAT student on how college friends who stay through good and bad times slowly become family.
